summary: RBAC bug-fix verification. Confirmed ADMIN_EMAILS = {secy.academics@iiml.ac.in} only. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_rbac_bugfix.py = 27/27 PASS. Both student tokens (stu_pgp41473 & stu_real) return role=student on /auth/me and receive 403 on all 7 admin GET endpoints (dashboard/requests/capacity/feasibility/students/audit/export) plus PUT /admin/window, PUT /admin/sections/{id}, POST /admin/import/termv. admintest_session returns role=admin and /admin/dashboard 200. critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: ADMIN_EMAILS restricted to a single dedicated admin email; role is recomputed on every /auth/session call (line 124-125) so any future removal of an email from ADMIN_EMAILS demotes existing user docs on next login — good.
Consider persisting admin emails in a config collection or env var (e.g. ADMIN_EMAILS from backend/.env) instead of a hardcoded set in server.py, so ops can rotate admins without a code change.
server.py is still 1086 lines — prior recommendation to split into modules stands (not related to this bug).
test_credentials: Bearer stu_pgp41473 / stu_real (students), Bearer admintest_session (admin). All three sessions present in Mongo user_sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_rbac_bugfix.py -v -n 0. Combined with existing test_termv_features.py (13/13) both suites are green. Frontend student view screenshots saved under /app/test_reports/student_*.png; admin view under admin_dashboard.png.
rca of the issue: Original bug: pgp41473@iiml.ac.in (real student DHARMANA CHANDRAMOULI, PGP41473) had been added to the ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist for admin testing. On login, create_session() computed role='admin' because email was in the set, and Layout.js then rendered the ADMIN_NAV. Fix (already applied by main agent): ADMIN_EMAILS = {'secy.academics@iiml.ac.in'} only; pgp41473 user doc converted back to role=student and given the correct PGPID; a separate admintest_session was created for secy.academics. Because role is recomputed on every /auth/session request, and require_admin/require_student enforce role server-side on every route, verification is now clean at both API and UI layers.
